ms.text:
MP1
additional apparatus:
voltmeter, protractor, metre rule
MP2
control variable (one from):
distance of lamp from solar panel
height of lamp / height of solar panel
brightness of lamp
MP3
method (one from):
measure angle between panel and stand / other fixed datum
(switch on lamp) measure potential difference
MP4
repeat for different angle
MP5
table:
appropriate columns with clear headings and units
MP6
analysis:
suitable analysis of readings, e.g. calculation of rate of change of potential difference with angle
draw a suitable graph with correct axes stated

MP7
additional point / precaution (one from):
reading with only ambient light first / subtract ambient light reading
make room dark
fix protractor
keep axis of solar panel and line of lamp perpendicular to each other
at least five sets of data taken
repeat each reading and take an average
repeat for different distance of lamp
